2610.13440.title: Revisiting Accent Classification with DistilHuBERT: Speaker-Disjoint Evaluation and Cross-Corpus Generalization
2610.13440.paper_summary: Recent accent classification systems can achieve high accuracy in standard in-corpus evaluations. However, when speakers overlap between the training and test sets, such results may overestimate model robustness compared with real-world deployment scenarios. This study revisits the robustness of DistilHuBERT-based accent classification by using L2-ARCTIC and multiple external English accent datasets. The comparison covers file-level and speaker-disjoint splits, along with balanced external-data training and teacher-student pseudo-labeling. The large performance gap between in-corpus and external evaluations suggests that file-level evaluation substantially overestimates performance, while speaker-disjoint evaluation can provide a more realistic estimate of the generalization to unseen speakers. In this study, models trained on external data alone do not reliably generalize to L2-ARCTIC. Among the tested configurations, balanced external-data training offers the most promising supervised setting. The pseudo-labeling experiments further indicate that confidence-based filtering alone is insufficient under domain mismatch. Overall, this study suggests that robust accent classification evaluation should simultaneously include speaker-disjoint evaluation and cross-corpus testing.
2610.13440.paper_summary_zh: 最近的口音分類系統在標準的語料庫內評估中可以達到高準確率。<lb/>然而，當說話者在訓練集和測試集之間重疊時，這樣的結果可能會高估模型的穩健性，與現實世界的部署情境相比。<lb/>本研究重新檢視基於DistilHuBERT的口音分類的穩健性，使用L2-ARCTIC和多個外部英語口音數據集。<lb/>比較涵蓋了文件級別和說話者不重疊的拆分，以及平衡的外部數據訓練和教師-學生偽標記。<lb/>語料庫內評估和外部評估之間的大性能差距表明，文件級評估實質上高估了性能，而說話者不重疊的評估可以提供對未見說話者的更現實的泛化估計。<lb/>在本研究中，僅在外部數據上訓練的模型並不可靠地泛化到L2-ARCTIC。<lb/>在測試的配置中，平衡的外部數據訓練提供了最有前景的監督設置。<lb/>偽標記實驗進一步表明，僅基於信心的過濾在領域不匹配的情況下是不足夠的。<lb/>總體而言，本研究建議穩健的口音分類評估應同時包括說話者不重疊的評估和跨語料庫測試。
